_comment: Synthetic NEGATIVE CONTROL (a): suspend-on-breach is regressed — a blocklist hit (a genuine threat that MUST suspend the VM mid-action) instead served an in-band error and let the VM ride through. A blocklist hit or an action:suspend rule must SUSPEND (D77, doc 03 §7 BIC). Must FAIL with the named class suspend-class-trip-did-not-suspend.
